# `sa_security_audit` — version 1.1

Source: `presets/security-audit/sa-security-audit.satz`

## Purpose

A read-only security-audit service account, with the group that may
impersonate it.

The pack combines several resource types (service account, group,
organization IAM), so — like the audit log sink — it goes at the top level of
the estate rather than under a single resource key.

After the apply, a human (not the tooling, which stays read-only) uses it:
prowler gcp --impersonate-service-account $SA --compliance cis_5.0_gcp ...
gcloud <cmd> --impersonate-service-account=$SA
gcloud auth application-default login --impersonate-service-account=$SA
The last one produces the impersonated ADC the Prowler CLI and the SCC
configuration read.

What this pack does NOT do:
- no API enablement in the seed project (impersonation needs
iamcredentials.googleapis.com — enable it separately)
- no service-account keys: access is by token-creator impersonation only
- no remediation rights: every role in the set is read-only

## Use it

```
params {
  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  security_audit_sa_project = ""
  security_audit_sa_name = "sa-security-audit"
  security_audit_sa_display_name = "Security Audit (read-only)"
  security_audit_auditors_group = "grp-security-auditors"
}

use "presets/security-audit/sa-security-audit.satz"
```

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `customer_domain` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `first_admin` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.

## Questions

What to ask before this pack is configured, and what changing the answer costs.

| asks about | prompt | reversal | blast | recommends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `security_audit_sa_project` | The project that hosts the security-audit service account | recreate | low | — |
| `security_audit_sa_name` | The service account's id (the part before @) | recreate | low | — |
| `security_audit_auditors_group` | The group whose members may impersonate the audit account (the local part) | recreate | low | — |

**security_audit_sa_project** — There is no default: customers name projects their own way, and the account's address is derived from the project. Moving it later is a new account and every auditor re-onboarded to it.


**security_audit_sa_name** — The account's address is its identity: renaming it is a new account, new grants, and every auditor's impersonation re-pointed.


**security_audit_auditors_group** — Membership of this group is what makes someone an auditor. Renaming it is a new group with every member moved by hand.
